title: Neptune's Winds Blow Faster Than the Speed of Sound

scenes.text: On Neptune, the wind blows faster than the speed of sound.
It's the windiest planet in the solar system, with gusts over 1,100 miles an hour.
That's roughly four times faster than the strongest winds ever recorded on Earth.
Voyager 2 flew past in 1989, the only spacecraft ever to visit.
Some measurements put the fastest winds above 1,200 miles an hour.
Supersonic wind, on the planet farthest from the Sun.

description:
Neptune has the fastest winds in the solar system, topping 1,100 miles an hour, faster than the speed of sound.
Earth's strongest winds reach about 250 miles an hour. Neptune is the farthest planet from the Sun, yet it has the most violent weather.
Which planet would you visit? Comment below.
first_comment: We have only ever visited Neptune once, with Voyager 2 in 1989. Should we send another probe?
